howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Understand the rules before booking.
howItWorks.intro: During SvS (State vs State), the alliance rotates the president role across 3 prep days. Whoever holds the role during the booked slot gets the matching buff.
rules: There are 3 days: Construction, Research and Troops.
Slots run from 00:00 to 23:30, in 30-minute blocks, always in UTC.
Each player (identified by game ID) can only book 1 slot per day.
The same ID can book slots on different days, even at the same clock time.
At the end of the month, an admin opens a new event and the schedule resets.
